title: Travel and tourism
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató az utazási élményeidről, a közlekedésről és a turizmusról kérdez. Válaszolj részletesen, indokold a véleményedet, és mondj példákat.

questions.q: What is the most memorable trip you have ever been on? Why?
Do you prefer organised tours or planning everything yourself?
What do you think of public transport in Hungary?
Is it better to travel abroad or to discover your own country? Why?
What should tourists see if they visit Hungary for the first time?
How has the internet changed the way people travel?
followUps: Do you trust online reviews of hotels and restaurants?

questions.q: Have you ever had a problem while travelling? What happened?
Would you like to travel alone one day? Why or why not?
Do you think tourism does more good or more harm to popular cities?
How do you think people will travel fifty years from now?

usefulPhrases.en: I prefer to plan everything myself.
Things didn't go according to plan.
usefulPhrases.hu: A dolgok nem a terv szerint alakultak.
